market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool has a strong core and deep financial resources, consistently finishing in the top four in five of the last six completed EPL seasons (2023-24 included). A new manager in 2024-25 introduced some transition risk, but the underlying squad quality and recruitment capacity suggest a ~60% chance of a top-four finish in 2025-26, above the market’s 52.5% implied probability.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished 3rd in 2023-24 and likely secured a top-four finish in 2024-25 under Arne Slot.
Squad still includes world-class performers like Mohamed Salah and Virgil van Dijk, plus quality depth in midfield and attack.
Historical resilience: only one top-four miss since 2017-18, with immediate bounce-back the following season.
sources_consulted: The Athletic Premier League season previews
